compression.tool: XZ Utils 5.2.5 in the locked M18 Linux/amd64 build environment

profile.role: single bootable normal distribution; QA media excluded

corresponding_sources.availability: Rebuild from the public qualified parent commit and pinned component gitlinks; generated host-side companion, not a second disk or committed build product

toolchain.open_watcom_release: official Open Watcom 1.9 final Linux i386 tools; exact executable hashes in the committed lock

guest_emulator.note: External guest-only dependency; ROMs and guest media are not public build inputs

scope: The exact designated D88 boots on VA and VA2 with the matched emulator executable; no hardware or physical keyboard result is claimed.

At 640 KiB installed on both models, English EDLIN edit/save/reopen, JWASMR small COM and relocated MZ assembly/execution, failure recovery, shell follow-up, and checked MCB ownership passed; no instantaneous RAM or disk peak was measured.

At 512 KiB installed with a retained larger selection, EDLIN save/reopen and the native 2HD B: FORMAT, CHKDSK and SYS workflow passed on VA and VA2. JWASMR sample assembly was rejected at DOS EXEC without output and without losing the checked shell; it is not a 512-KiB assembly PASS.

Both exact SYS-produced 2HD B: disks booted and wrote/read files; separate write-protected normal A:, live-swapped native B:, and nonbooting 2D B: QA checks were performed and kept out of this distribution.
CHKDSK A: redirected output can be empty (public issue #12) and is not counted as an A: filesystem-check PASS. Independently read-back B: checks remain scoped successes.
limits: 256 KiB EDLIN editing is not qualified; an earlier source-bound attempt reported out of memory and recovered the shell.
640 KiB installed, not merely a retained 640-KiB selection, is the qualified small edit/assemble/run sample setting; arbitrary source sizes are not guaranteed.
DOS MCB reports do not establish physical firmware or VRAM ownership; useful in-program RAM and instantaneous disk-workspace peaks remain unmeasured by owner decision.
SASI/SCSI, hard-disk boot, all-floppy-format maintenance, exhaustive 8086 linked-opcode proof, and actual hardware validation are outside this M18 result.
